sara: Quick follow-up from the PM postmortemwe still have 3 open actions: cache mitigation, regression eval, and incident-pattern mapping. Need owners + tickets.
mike: I can own cache mitigation + PR. Will open Jira and add ACs.
nina: I'll take regression evals and CI check. Will write an automated job.
raj: I'll map past incidents and attach diagnostics to the ticket.
pm-bot: Jira RW-4120 created by @mike - https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/RW-4120
mike: RW-4120: reduce kv retention + eviction backpressure. Assignee=mike. ETA PR by 2026-04-10. AC: no sustained kv_cache_size increase >12% under synthetic load for 24h.
nina: I'll produce the eval prompt and CI job. AC: nightly job must detect >8% memory regression and fail.
raj: Grep snippets I'll attach to RW-4120:
```
zgrep "kv_cache_size" /var/log/* | sort -k3 -n | tail -n 50
awk '/eviction/ || /oom/ {print $0}' /var/log/incidents.log | sed -n '1,200p'
```
sara: Add a tiny RACI in the ticket: Mike=R, Nina=A (evals), Raj=C, Sara=I. Also link incidents 2026-02-18 and 2026-03-12.
mike: Handing rollout checklist to @nina; I keep code ownership.
pm-bot: Reminder: follow-up sync RW-4120 scheduled 2026-04-09 09:00 UTC
sara: Let's aim to close PM follow-up by 2026-04-17 if canary passes. Short sync Wed 09:00 UTC to confirm.
mike: ack :thumbsup:
